normalization: targets = totals * FINAL_INNER_SIZE / n, i.e. proportional to the 5/27 share of the full TRAIN population's eligible/positive/negative window totals
objective_formula: ((inner_windows - target_windows) / target_windows)^2 + ((inner_positive - target_positive) / target_positive)^2 + ((inner_negative - target_negative) / target_negative)^2
